name: PORT
description: Port used by the native HTTP API. Change this if another service already uses the port.

name: SCRAPE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
description: Default scrape deadline in milliseconds; per-request maxTimeout takes precedence.

name: SCRAPE_MIN_TIER
description: Minimum execution tier: 1 uses HTTP first; 3 always uses the Android System WebView.

name: HOST
description: HTTP listener address. Managed local instances use 127.0.0.1.

name: SCRAPE_MAX_TIER
description: Maximum execution tier: 1 allows HTTP only; 3 also allows Android System WebView rendering.

name: API_KEY
description: Bearer key for clients connecting to this Android server. A private key is generated automatically. Enter your own key of at least 16 characters to connect another client.
